The shift from robot demos to memory and evaluation, a few other things that stood out at CoRL 2026:

1. Data is getting labeled and not filtered
- π0.7 tagged every episode with speed, quality and mistakes instead of throwing the bad ones out
- Matched experienced teleops folding shirts on a robot that it had no previous task data for

2. The scoreboards are shaky
- A 90M model that never reads the instruction scores 97.6% on LIBERO
- 1/5 LIBERO SOTA claims held up

3. Memory is the next scaling axis
- Same model on 8k steps of context vs 1k showed 62% better results
- Poor generalization is the robot forgetting what it just did.

4. Touch and tactlie is in but force isn’t yet
- Lots of tactile work, especially on dexterous hands
-  But the loop on an actual force target isn't closed

5. Big tech had no demos
- Apple and Meta both had booths with nothing to showcase
- Apple was recruiting for a project it couldn’t describe while Meta was pitching a consumer humanoid
